## Research Question

How does my daily usage of five apps vary over two weeks?

## Data

I recorded daily usage of Xiaohongshu, Fanqie Novel, QQ, Douyin, and WeChat from October 12 to October 25, 2026.

The dataset contains 70 observations. Each observation represents one app on one day. Usage is measured in minutes.

Source: Apple Screen Time.

```{r}
screen_time <- read.csv("screen_time.csv")
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
screen_time$plot_date <- as.Date(
  screen_time$date,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)
```

## Visualization
```{r}
ggplot(screen_time,
       aes(x = plot_date, y = minutes, fill = app)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 day",
    date_labels = "%m/%d"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "My Screen Time Across Five Apps",
    subtitle = "October 12–25, 2026",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily usage (minutes)",
    fill = "App",
    caption = "Jiwei | Source: Apple Screen Time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "screen_time_v1.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
